loze / is Determination Of

is Determination Of

Property

The relation that obtains between a schematic particular x and another schematic particular y if and only if x has all the essential properties of y together with further essential properties that y lacks

https://loze-ontology.org/isDeterminationOf

For example

The Toyota Corolla Hatchback is a determination of the Toyota Corolla; the 1869 version of War and Peace is a determination of War and Peace; Apocalypse Now Redux is a determination of Apocalypse Now; heavy water is a determination of water; anthracite is a determination of coal; carbon-14 is a determination of carbon

Note

If x is a concretization of y and y is a determination of z, then x is also a concretization of z; one unit of the Toyota Corolla hatchback is also a unit of the Toyota Corolla; a heavy water molecule is a water molecule; and so on

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
